name: Forwarding of Discrimination Reports to Title IX Coordinator
description: Reports of Title IX sex discrimination, other discrimination or retaliation received by any employee must be forwarded to the Title IX Coordinator for response and investigation.
recipient: Title IX Coordinator (or Superintendent if Coordinator is the subject)
quote: In the event a report of Title IX sex discrimination, other discrimination, or retaliation is received by a school employee other than the Title IX Coordinator , such report shall promptly be forwarded to the Title IX Coordinator
